summary: Configured datauser with a filesystem-enforced 100 MiB hard quota on /srv/data. The quota, account, data, and service health persisted across node1’s restart.

Applied a 100 MiB hard limit to /srv/data
Verified the limit using real writes before and after restart
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed full recovery
